# Set-up
```{r}

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "lme4", "tidyverse", "here", "emmeans")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

require(knitr)
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(emmeans)

inport_dir <- here("data")

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# set default plot theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 18)))

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)
```

# Data

Read in data:

```{r}

df.e4_vr_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e4_vrdata.csv"), header = T)

```

Clean data:

```{r}
#Exclusions
# NOTE: Exclude. == 1 marks one participant, the "experimenter error" in the
# Methods. The file doesn't record the reason
df.e4_vr <- df.e4_vr_raw |>
  filter(id != "") |>
  filter(Exclude. == 0) |>
  select(id, Friction_Level, contains("Difficulty"), contains("Sec"),
         Gender, Age)

# Renaming Trial Conditions for both difficulty and time
e4_tower_names <- c(X5H_Difficulty = "5 Horizontal",
               X10H_Difficulty = "10 Horizontal",
               X3x3_Difficulty = "3x3",
               X5V_Difficulty = "5 Vertical",
               LShape_Difficulty = "L-Shaped",
               X10V_Difficulty = "10 Vertical")

# Reshape difficulty data
df.e4_vr_diff <- df.e4_vr %>%
  select(id, Friction_Level, contains("Difficulty"), Gender, Age) %>%
  gather(key = "Tower_Type",
         value = "Difficulty",
         X5H_Difficulty:LShape_Difficulty,
         factor_key = TRUE)

# Reshape time data
df.e4_vr_time <- df.e4_vr %>%
  select(id, Friction_Level, contains("Sec"), Gender, Age) %>%
  gather(key = "Tower_Type",
         value = "Time",
         X5H_Sec:LShape_Sec,
         factor_key = TRUE)

# Clean up the Tower_Type names to match
df.e4_vr_time$Tower_Type <- gsub("_Sec", "_Difficulty", df.e4_vr_time$Tower_Type)

# Combine the dataframes
df.e4_vr <- df.e4_vr_diff %>%
  left_join(df.e4_vr_time, by = c("id", "Friction_Level", "Gender", "Age", "Tower_Type"))

# Rest of processing
df.e4_vr$Difficulty <- as.numeric(as.character(df.e4_vr$Difficulty))
df.e4_vr$Time <- as.numeric(as.character(df.e4_vr$Time))
df.e4_vr$Tower_Type <- factor(df.e4_vr$Tower_Type,
                              levels = names(e4_tower_names),
                              labels = e4_tower_names)

# Convert columns to factor
df.e4_vr <- df.e4_vr |>
  mutate(Friction_Level = as.factor(Friction_Level))

```

# Process Cleaned Data

# Demographic Information

```{r}

df.e4_vr |>
  distinct(id, Gender) |>
  mutate(Gender = trimws(Gender)) |>
  count(Gender)

# Age was collected in bins
df.e4_vr |>
  distinct(id, Age) |>
  count(Age)

```

# Analyses

Effect of Difficulty

```{r}

# Creating and ordering by verticality (higher is more vertical here)
df.e4_vr <- df.e4_vr |>
    mutate(verticality = ifelse(Tower_Type == "5 Horizontal", 1,
                ifelse(Tower_Type == "10 Horizontal", 1,
                       ifelse(Tower_Type == "3x3", 3,
                              ifelse(Tower_Type == "5 Vertical", 5,
                                     ifelse(Tower_Type == "L-Shaped", 6,
                                            ifelse(Tower_Type == "10 Vertical", 10, NA)))))))

# LME main effect of verticality and friction on difficulty and interaction
lmer(Difficulty ~ verticality*Friction_Level + (1|id),
     data = df.e4_vr) |>
  joint_tests()

```
